question: Friction depends on the smoothness of the surfaces. The force of friction always ______ the applied forces.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Opposes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Friction__: 

 
 
• **The property of a surface that opposes the relative motion between two surfaces is called friction.**
 
• The force that opposes the motion of an object is called **frictional force**.
 
• **Friction** (f) = μN
 
• Where μ is the **coefficient of friction** and N is the **normal force**.
 
• Friction is caused by the irregularities on the two surfaces in contact.
 
• Friction depends on the nature of surfaces in contact.
 
• The force of friction is greater if a rough surface is involved.
 
• **The force of friction always opposes the applied force. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
